verses.1: And if you hear the voice of the LORD your God, and keep all His commands, then I will give you over to all the nations of the earth.
verses.2: And all these blessings will come upon you, and they will bless you, so that you may hear the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.3: Blessed are you in the city, and blessed are you in the field.
verses.4: Blessed be the fruits of your womb, and the fruits of your land, and the fruits of your livestock. May they bring you abundance in all your endeavors.
verses.5: Blessed be your name and your dwelling place.
verses.6: Blessed are you in your entry, and blessed are you in your departure.
verses.7: The LORD will give you back those who have been against you, who have been hostile to you. They will come to you in one way, but they will also come to you in seven different ways.
verses.8: The LORD commands you to bless those whom you touch with your hands, and to bless all those places where you place your hands. He also blesses the land that the LORD, your God, gives you as a gift.
verses.9: May the LORD make you a holy people, just as He promised. For you have kept the commandments of the LORD your God, and you have walked in His ways.
verses.10: And all the nations of the earth shall see that the name of the LORD is called upon over you, and they shall fear you.
verses.11: And may the LORD be good to you in all your fruits from your womb, and in all your harvests from your fields. May He bless you with the land that the LORD has promised to your ancestors, so that you may inherit it.
verses.12: The LORD will open up for you His good gifts from heaven, so that they may fall upon your land at that time. He will bless all your works. Many nations will be blessed, but you yourself will not be blessed.
verses.13: And Jehovah will give you a head, not a tail. You will be solely for good purposes, and not for evil ones. For you shall hear the commands of Jehovah your God, who has commanded you today to keep them and to carry them out.
verses.14: And do not forget any of the things I command you today. You must go after other gods and worship them instead of God.
verses.15: And if you do not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, and do not keep all His commandments and laws that I command you today, then all these curses will come upon you.
verses.16: You are in the city, and you are also in the field.
verses.17: May your enemies and those who oppose you be destroyed.
verses.18: May the fruits of your body and the fruits of your land be abundant for you. May all your desires be fulfilled.
verses.19: You are happy when you enter, and you are also happy when you leave.
verses.20: The LORD will send upon you plague, destruction, and devastation in all the places where you act. You will be destroyed quickly by your enemy who has abandoned you.
verses.21: May the LORD fulfill His words to you completely. You shall rule over the land that You have received from Him.
verses.22: May the LORD destroy you with the sword, with arrows, with bombs, with fire, and with all other weapons. May He bring you to ruin.
verses.23: And your head shall be covered with a crown, and the earth beneath you shall be made of bronze.
verses.24: The LORD will give you rain from the heavens, and hail will fall upon you until your fields are full.
verses.25: The LORD will give you a victory before your enemies. You will go out against them in one way, and in seven different ways you will defeat them. Then you will be feared by all the kings of the earth.
verses.26: And your carcass will become food for all the birds in the sky, and for the animals on the earth. There will be no one who does not eat it.
verses.27: May the LORD destroy Egypt, as well as its enemies, its borders, and its cities that cannot be rebuilt.
verses.28: May the LORD punish them in their pride, their foolishness, and their wickedness.
verses.29: And you would be in darkness during the day, just as the lamp is extinguished in the darkness. You would not be able to walk your way forward. You would remain lost and homeless all those days. And there would be no one to save you.
verses.30: A woman will be taken away, and another man will be placed in the house. She will not sit there; she will not plant any seeds or cause anything to grow there.
verses.31: Your eyes shall rejoice, and you shall not eat from it. Your enemy will not be able to harm you anymore. Your possessions will not be given back to your enemies. You will have no one to help you.
verses.32: Your sons and daughters are given to another people. Your eyes see all their actions every day. But you have no control over them.
verses.33: The fruits of your land and all that you produce will be eaten by people whom you know not. You will remain worthless and foolish all your days.
verses.34: And you will be dazzled by what your eyes will see.
verses.35: May the LORD pour out evil upon your wounds and ailments, those that cannot be healed from your feet to your knees.
verses.36: The LORD will go with you and your king, who will establish you in a land that you and your ancestors have never known before. There, you will serve other gods, who are made of wood and stone.
verses.37: And you will become a name among all the nations, a leader and a ruler over them. This will be because Jehovah has appointed you to rule over them.
verses.38: The seeds that are sown in the field will not bear fruit, and they will be gathered up when the harvest comes.
verses.39: You shall plant vines and serve them. But do not drink their juice, nor store it away, for the locusts will eat them.
verses.40: Thorns will be your covering on all your borders, and you shall not plant vines there, for your thorns will make them bitter.
verses.41: Sons and daughters will be born, but they will not be your own. They will go away from you.
verses.42: All your trees and all the fruits of your land will be inherited by the locusts.
verses.43: The foreigner who is near you will rise up against you, higher and higher. And you will be forced to descend, lower and lower.
verses.44: He will reign, and you will not reign. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
verses.45: And all these curses came upon you; they pursued you and trapped you until you were completely destroyed. For you did not listen to the voice of Yahweh your God, who commanded you to keep His laws and commandments.
verses.46: And may there be joy and peace in you, and in your descendants, forever.
verses.47: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and in good heart, from all that You had.
verses.48: And you served your enemies, who Jehovah sent against you during times of famine and thirst, in cities where there was nothing to eat. They put iron rings on your chests until they destroyed you completely.
verses.49: The LORD will bring a nation from far away to rule over you, when that nation becomes powerful and no one will be able to hear their words.
verses.50: A nation with a hard exterior, whose people never show respect for the elderly or young people.
verses.51: And he will eat the fruits of your land and the fruits of your vine, until you are destroyed. There will be no more grain to eat, no more fruit to gather from your fields, and no more crops to harvest from your land.
verses.52: And there will be gates that are closed for you in every city, until the time comes when your hot winds blow through them. These gates are what you trust in all over your land. There will also be gates that are closed for you in every city throughout your land, as God, your God, has decreed.
verses.53: And you shall eat the fruit of your own belly, your sons and daughters who Jehovah your God has given you in the land that He promised to give you. They are the ones who were taken captive by your enemies.
verses.54: The man who was dear to you became very sad. His eyes were filled with sorrow, because of his brother, his wife, and all his children who were left behind.
verses.55: From among them, choose one of their children who will eat without having to keep all the food in a container or basket. This person will be like your enemy at every door of your house.
verses.56: The pain in you, and the suffering that never ceases… It spreads across the land, causing sorrow and pain. It affects her eyes, her children, and her household.
verses.57: And in her womb, she will give birth to children. She will bring them into the world, so that they can be eaten without any shame, in a secret place, in a cave where your enemy can find them.
verses.58: If you do not keep all the words of this Torah that are written in this book, then you will not be able to see the holy and glorious name of Jehovah your God.
verses.59: And Jehovah will surely destroy your crops, as well as the crops of your descendants. He will destroy both good and bad crops, both healthy and sick ones.
verses.60: And I will bring back to you all those nations that you have scattered from their land, and they will come back to you.
verses.61: And all those who are sick and all those who are harmed, but who are not recorded in this Book of Laws, they will be destroyed by Jehovah. They will be destroyed until you are healed.
verses.62: And you remained in a state of darkness, just as you were like stars in the sky. You did not hear the voice of the LORD your God at all.
verses.63: And it shall be that when Jehovah makes you prosper, and increases your numbers, then Jehovah will also take away from you everything that He has given you. He will destroy you and scatter you from the land that You have come to possess.
verses.64: And Jehovah has scattered you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to another. There, you served other gods whom you and your ancestors did not know—gods who are nothing but trees and stones.
verses.65: And in those nations, you shall not rest, nor be at ease on your feet. The LORD will give you there a hard heart, and eyes full of hatred, and a spirit of destruction.
verses.66: And your lives will be in danger from all sides. You will be afraid at night and during the day. Do not trust your own lives at all.
verses.67: In the morning, it will say, “Who will give me evening?” And in the evening, it will say, “Who will give me morning?” Out of fear for your heart, which is filled with fear, and because of what your eyes see.
verses.68: But Jehovah will bring you back from Egypt by sea, along the way I have told you not to go there anymore. There, you will become slaves and wives of your enemies. You will have no property at all.
verses.69: These are the terms of the covenant that Yahweh commanded Moses to establish with the children of Israel in Moab, just as He also established the covenant with them in Canaan.
